cases.reason: Author review for 4.6.106 (release captain Claude phemex-testnet runner, Nov 28 2026): one bug fix on top of 4.6.105 (candidate 73f61b1c). lumibot/brokers/ccxt.py: set_order_read_markets also accepts a bare base symbol and reads that base's active markets, so order cancels on Phemex no longer scan every market. Live CCXT broker only; the retained cases bind the synchronous Pandas fixture and BacktestingBroker and never construct the Ccxt broker. No prompt, skill, tool schema, model wrapper or fixture changed; zero new model runs. Author review for 4.6.105 (release captain Claude topstepx runner, Nov 28 2026): one bug fix on top of 4.6.104 (candidate e9c60752). lumibot/data_sources/ccxt_data.py: a widened live CCXT history lookback stops at 2009-01-03 instead of moving before 1970. The retained cases bind the synchronous Pandas fixture and BacktestingBroker and never construct CCXT data. No prompt, skill, tool schema, model wrapper or fixture changed; zero new model runs. Author review for 4.6.104 (release captain Claude phemex-testnet runner, Nov 28 2026): lumibot/brokers/ccxt.py Phemex time-in-force words and 39108 wallet skip; live CCXT broker only, never constructed by this case. Author review for 4.6.103 (release captain Claude topstepx runner, Nov 28 2026): bug fixes on top of 4.6.102. Runtime files changed: lumibot/tools/projectx_helpers.py and lumibot/brokers/projectx.py (ProjectX read calls retry HTTP 429 with Retry-After capped at 10 s; order writes unchanged; connect keeps the real failure reason); lumibot/brokers/schwab.py (bots sharing one Schwab login fall back to polling their own working orders when Schwab refuses the order stream). lumibot/strategies/_strategy.py (the end-of-run benchmark read runs with a bounded wait and never fails a finished backtest); the retained fixtures bypass the full strategy runner and reports, so they never read a benchmark. Both are live broker adapters that the retained cases never construct: they bind the synchronous Pandas fixture and BacktestingBroker. No prompt, skill, tool schema, model wrapper or fixture changed; zero new model runs. Author review for 4.6.102 (release captain Claude, Nov 27 2026): bug fixes on top of 4.6.101 (candidate 41db654a). lumibot/backtesting/routed_backtesting.py: assets the strategy supplies in pandas_data are served from pandas_data when a routing map is set; lumibot/tools/data_downloader_queue_client.py: a pending unstarted downloader request whose queue position does not move for LUMIBOT_QUEUE_STALL_SECONDS fails with a plain reason. The retained cases bind the synchronous Pandas fixture and BacktestingBroker; they never construct RoutedBacktestingPandas or the downloader queue client. No prompt, skill, tool schema, model wrapper or fixture changed; zero new model runs. Author review for 4.6.101 (release captain Claude, Nov 27 2026): one bug fix on top of the dev candidate already author-reviewed for MetaMask parity (fingerprint 6e7433a3). Runtime change: lumibot/brokers/alpaca.py _await_market_to_close no longer calls the backtesting-only process_pending_orders (PR #1253). Live Alpaca is never constructed by the retained cases, which bind the synchronous Pandas fixture and BacktestingBroker. No prompt, skill, tool schema, model wrapper or fixture changed; zero new model runs. Preserve the original passing native proof for options_single_leg_chain_and_quote. Author review for 4.6.85 (one change. lumibot/tools/ibkr_helper.py: the minimum age before an Interactive Brokers daily session can be remembered as confirmed missing is measured on the New York calendar instead of the UTC date. The retained option and attention cases run on the in-memory Pandas fixture and never read Interactive Brokers history, so nothing they see can change. No prompt, skill, tool schema, model wrapper or fixture changed; zero new model runs): previous review, still true: Author review for 4.6.84 (one change. lumibot/brokers/broker.py get_time_to_close and market_close_time use the initialized-calendar session that contains now, and lumibot/strategies/strategy_executor.py _ensure_progress_inside_open_session nudges only backtesting brokers. Backtesting brokers override get_time_to_close and market_close_time and keep the nudge exactly as before; the retained option and attention cases run on the in-memory Pandas backtesting fixture, so their clocks, fills, prices, positions and messages are unchanged. The IBKR daily history changes in this version touch Interactive Brokers history only, which those fixtures never read. No prompt, skill, tool schema, model wrapper or fixture changed; zero new model runs): previous review, still true: Author review for 4.6.83 (four changes. lumibot/tools/backtest_cache.py: an opt-in read-only fallback cache mode chosen by an environment variable; the default is unchanged and the retained cases use no remote cache. lumibot/backtesting/backtesting_broker.py: the market-style fallback of a multi-leg SMART_LIMIT package prices every leg before filling and uses the market package's quote, trade or labeled estimate for an option leg with no bar; it is reached only when a package has no usable bid and ask, and packages whose legs all have bars fill as before. The retained option and attention fixtures supply complete observed prices on every bar they trade, so the no-quote fallback is not reached and their fills, prices, positions and messages are unchanged. lumibot/tools/ibkr_helper.py: Interactive Brokers contract lookup for a share class written with a dot, space or dash; the in-memory Pandas fixtures never read Interactive Brokers. lumibot/tools/indicators.py: Total Return is written with two decimals in the tearsheet CSV and metrics JSON after the simulation ends; every maintained native fixture sets analyze_backtest=False. No prompt, skill, tool schema, model wrapper or fixture changed; zero new model runs): previous review, still true: Author review for 4.6.82 (two changes. lumibot/tools/indicators.py: the tearsheet step writes the strategy's own metrics when the benchmark is missing, flat or does not cover the window; a covering benchmark is unchanged, and this runs after the simulation ends, so nothing a model sees during a case changes. lumibot/fundamentals/sec.py, lumibot/backtesting/alpaca_backtesting.py and lumibot/tools/shared_bar_cache.py: monthly SEC fundamentals tables load filing times and cover-page share counts from small per-company cache files and Alpaca daily marks index the trading calendar once; 13 market cap tables for 503 companies are identical value for value, and an empty cache partition frame equals the old one. The retained option and attention cases run on the in-memory Pandas fixture and never call self.fundamentals, AlpacaBacktesting or the shared bar cache. No prompt, skill, tool schema, model wrapper or fixture changed; zero new model runs): previous review, still true: Author review for 4.6.81 (one change in lumibot/indicators/indicators.py: in backtests 26 listed built-in indicators are calculated once over the stored bar series and the current bar's row is read, instead of recalculating on every bar. tests/test_indicators_call_cost.py compares both paths bar by bar for every listed name and they return the same values, so any indicator value a retained option or attention case can read is unchanged; nothing else those fixtures use changed. No prompt, skill, tool schema, model wrapper or fixture changed; zero new model runs): previous review, still true: Author review for 4.6.80 (one change in lumibot/tools/ibkr_helper.py: the Interactive Brokers futures hole check measures gaps in bars of the series and remembers an empty provider answer. The retained option and attention cases run on the in-memory Pandas fixture and never read Interactive Brokers history, so nothing they see can change. No prompt, skill, tool schema, model wrapper or fixture changed; zero new model runs): previous review, still true: Author review for 4.6.79 (one change in lumibot/backtesting/backtesting_broker.py: the option fill estimate no longer returns nothing when the contract's last real trade is at or below its no-volatility value; it estimates with no time value instead. That branch is reached only for an order with no quote and no trade on its bar; the retained option and attention fixtures supply complete observed prices on every bar they trade, so their fills, prices, positions and messages are unchanged. Only option fills that could not happen before can change. No prompt, skill, tool schema, model wrapper or fixture changed; zero new model runs): previous review, still true: Author review for 4.6.78 (one change in lumibot/fundamentals/sec.py: a filing at the wrong scale is not read as a stock split and its reversal; the retained in-memory Pandas option and attention fixtures never call self.fundamentals): previous review, still true: Author review for 4.6.77 (market cap accuracy; changes confined to lumibot/fundamentals/sec.py, two default-None DataSource hooks and their AlpacaBacktesting implementation, none of which this in-memory Pandas option fixture calls): previous review, still true: Author review for 4.6.76 (futures reopening valuation, futures minute hole repair, read-only fallback cache, perpetual end date, short-history lookback; all broker/data code the retained in-memory Pandas option/attention fixtures never reach): native partial order executions now revisit only the owned remainder, deduplicate pending snapshots, cap execution at remaining quantity, preserve the terminal weighted average and charge fees on actual execution units. The retained option and attention cases use flat_options_account/flat_options_multi_session through the unchanged PandasDataBacktesting fixture and _FixtureBroker; no partial-quantity hook, perpetual settlement engine or custom fill model is configured. Their ordinary executions have no earlier partial transactions, so the weighted expression equals the same full-execution price and their fees, cash, orders and model-visible results stay unchanged. Provider-diagnostic edits change only unavailable CCXT/Binance messages, which these successful Pandas fixtures never use. No prompt, skill, schema, model wrapper, fixture or price source changed. Retain original actor/judge SDKs, source commits, dates, call identities, usage and verdicts. The source-identical red-first native partial-fill and provider-diagnostic proofs are reused; zero new model calls or hosted execution is claimed.
